_doc: Tone-fidelity reference for the permanent upscaler cells.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: until 2026-08-28 the upscaler cells asserted
output DIMENSIONS only. A defect that shifted every swin2sr output by
the model's RGB mean (grey background instead of white, crushed dark
side) shipped to the hub and survived every gate, because no cell ever
looked at a VALUE. Shape gates are structurally blind to tone.
input mean 180.70, background 254/254/254). Four independent vendor
The observed defect sat at mean 95.15 (delta -85.55), bg 139,142,150.
The tolerances below clear the worst CORRECT arm by ~3x and sit ~10x
under the defect. They are measurements, not guesses: widen one only
against a new vendor measurement recorded in this file.
vendor_measured_hw: the vendor arms above were measured on the 448 asset; the vendor half of the assertion only applies to a cell that ran at that size.
known_defect is a string (all cells) or a map keyed by 'size' or '<engine>-<size>', so a defect that only shows on one engine or at one size is marked exactly where it happens and nowhere else.

background_probe._note: Median over the four corner patches. Valid because the fixture asset has uniform background at all four corners; a fixture without that property needs a different probe.

hat-l-x4._engines_note: triton support in progress (docs/upscalers/index.md); add it here when it lands.

swin2SR-classical-sr-x2-64._vendor_note: No banked vendor arm yet — the input-referenced half still applies and is what catches the mean-addback class.

known_defect.compiled-trace: swin2sr-x2 residual defect, DISTINCT from the RGB-mean class that the root-trace-unit fix closed (background is restored: 254 against an input 254). The image is too dark and the two engines disagree with each other — measured 2026-08-28 at 448: compiled mean 41.26, triton 108.34, input 180.70; at the 112x80 trace size compiled 169.03, triton 176.39. Engine disagreement rules out a shared-path defect. x2 is the only single-stage-upsample variant. See FINDING_SWIN2SR_X2_RESIDUAL.md.
